entries.title: Monday reset
entries.content: Started the week with a proper morning routine for once. Woke up before the alarm, which felt strange but good. Going to try to keep this going.

entries.title: A slower day
entries.content: Didn't get much done today and I'm trying not to be hard on myself about it. Read for a while in the evening instead of scrolling, that felt like a small win.
Today I finally stuck to my morning routine without snoozing. Small thing, but it set the tone for the rest of the day.
